name: Tow float, 20 litre
description: Two air chambers and a dry pocket for keys and a phone. Clips to the waist and trails a metre behind you.

name: Cap strobe
description: Clips under a swim cap strap. Three flash patterns, visible from 800 metres on a clear night.

name: Bright silicone cap
description: Thick silicone in a colour that shows up against grey water.

name: Thermal cap, 3 mm
description: Fleece-lined neoprene with a chin strap. For water below 12 degrees.

name: Swim gloves, 3 mm
description: Smooth palm for a clean catch, long cuff to keep flushing down.

name: Swim socks, 3 mm
description: Taped seams and a grippy sole for getting across shingle.

name: Low-light goggles
description: Clear amber lens for dawn swims, wide gasket that stays put in chop.

name: Polarised goggles
description: Cuts glare on flat, sunny water so you can sight the next buoy.

name: Changing robe
description: Windproof shell, deep fleece, sleeves wide enough to pull your arms inside.

name: Shingle mat
description: Stand on it to change, then cinch the edge to carry your wet kit home.

name: Tide clock
description: One hand, one job: hours to the next high water. Last one until the maker's spring batch.

name: Steel flask, 750 ml
description: Keeps tea hot for nine hours. The cup is sized for gloved hands.
